options: A: keep the measured top and the checked radios; narrow pixel exemption for the two popup states (proposed-exemptions.json)
B: hard-code top 204px to match the capture (diverges from the original's measurement on other headers)
answer: A (recommended), auto-accepted (user instruction 2026-10-16 night): keep the measured popup top and the checked radios; narrow pixel exemption on the two popup states (capture artifacts)
